mermaid.min.js: Mermaid 11.17.2 (MIT), the mermaid@11 dist build from the npm registry.
Vendored so the published site fetches nothing from third parties (about 3.4 MB, an
accepted cost of that sovereignty, see #61). Material loads its own copy only when
`mermaid` is undefined; extra_javascript in mkdocs.yml defines it first.
To update: replace the file and bump the version in this note.
